subject: [RFC PATCH 37/57] mm/collapse: report what the fault-in pass paid

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds reporting of faults taken during the fault-in pass in the Linux kernel's memory collapse functionality. The fault-in pass is responsible for handling swap reads and CoW breaks, but its performance was previously invisible. This patch introduces a new trace event called mm_collapse_faultin that captures the number of faults taken and their outcome. This information will help identify slow collapses or khugepaged workloads. The reporting occurs before the walk and after the mmap_lock is dropped on failure to ensure safety.
